Guidance recovery mentions JavaScript reset; neither that text nor the supplied js_reset description establishes control release. No reset, debugger detach, application closure, Escape injection or helper protocol was used or treated as release.
The new native getApp entry point does not by itself satisfy the user-required release operation plus verifiable receipt/status.
